This is a backtest, not a live forecast.We built it after Election Day. Each day's numbers use only polls that had been released by that date, so they show what this model would have said at the time. We have not scored it against the results yet.

2026 US Senate forecast

On Election Day the model gave Democrats a 71% chance of controlling the Senate and Republicans 29%. Independents held the balance in 1% of simulations.
